title: Couverture sinistre — Réponses
description: Ce que le système répond, ce que ses contrôles rattrapent, et ce qui lui manque. Source : table `analyses`.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS analyses FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS analyses FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()

panels.title: Part d'INCERTAIN
panels.description: Trop haut : le système ne tranche presque jamais. Trop bas sur des cas ambigus : il tranche au hasard.

targets.queryText: SELECT AVG(decision = 'INCERTAIN') AS incertain FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT AVG(decision = 'INCERTAIN') AS incertain FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()

panels.title: Réponses fermes (couvert / non couvert)
panels.description: Part des réponses tranchées sans question à poser.

targets.queryText: SELECT AVG(decision != 'INCERTAIN') AS fermes FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT AVG(decision != 'INCERTAIN') AS fermes FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS erreurs FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NOT NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS erreurs FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NOT NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()

targets.queryText:
SELECT unixepoch(date(date)) AS time,
       SUM(decision = 'COUVERT') AS couvert,
       SUM(decision = 'NON_COUVERT') AS non_couvert,
       SUM(decision = 'INCERTAIN') AS incertain
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY date(date) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT unixepoch(date(date)) AS time,
       SUM(decision = 'COUVERT') AS couvert,
       SUM(decision = 'NON_COUVERT') AS non_couvert,
       SUM(decision = 'INCERTAIN') AS incertain
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY date(date) ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT unixepoch(date(date)) AS time, AVG(decision = 'INCERTAIN') AS incertain FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY date(date) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Part des tokens envoyés repris du cache
panels.description: Repris du cache, un token envoyé coûte environ dix fois moins.

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(tokens_cache) / NULLIF(SUM(tokens_envoyes), 0), 2) AS cache FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() AND methode = 'clauses'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(tokens_cache) / NULLIF(SUM(tokens_envoyes), 0), 2) AS cache FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() AND methode = 'clauses'

panels.title: Les deux méthodes, côte à côte

targets.queryText:
SELECT methode, COUNT(*) AS analyses,
       ROUND(AVG(decision = 'INCERTAIN'), 2) AS part_incertain,
       CAST(AVG(duree_ms) AS INTEGER) AS duree_moyenne_ms,
       CAST(AVG(tokens_envoyes) AS INTEGER) AS tokens_envoyes_moyens,
       CAST(AVG(tokens_recus) AS INTEGER) AS tokens_recus_moyens,
       ROUND(AVG(cout_usd), 3) AS cout_moyen_usd
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY methode ORDER BY analyses DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT methode, COUNT(*) AS analyses,
       ROUND(AVG(decision = 'INCERTAIN'), 2) AS part_incertain,
       CAST(AVG(duree_ms) AS INTEGER) AS duree_moyenne_ms,
       CAST(AVG(tokens_envoyes) AS INTEGER) AS tokens_envoyes_moyens,
       CAST(AVG(tokens_recus) AS INTEGER) AS tokens_recus_moyens,
       ROUND(AVG(cout_usd), 3) AS cout_moyen_usd
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY methode ORDER BY analyses DESC

panels.title: Fiabilité : ce que les contrôles rattrapent
Rattrapages par jour
panels.description: Réponses corrigées par le contrôle des citations, citations ou conditions écartées faute de preuve.

targets.queryText:
SELECT unixepoch(date(date)) AS time,
       SUM(decision_initiale != decision) AS corrigees_par_controle,
       SUM(citations_rejetees + conditions_ecartees) AS preuves_ecartees
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY date(date) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT unixepoch(date(date)) AS time,

       SUM(citations_rejetees + conditions_ecartees) AS preuves_ecartees
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()

targets.queryText: SELECT unixepoch(date(date)) AS time, AVG(duree_ms) AS moyen, MAX(duree_ms) AS maximum FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY date(date) ORDER BY time

panels.title: INCERTAIN par contrat
panels.description: Un contrat dont la part d'INCERTAIN est anormale est souvent un contrat mal lu.

targets.queryText:
SELECT contrat_id AS contrat, COUNT(*) AS analyses,
       ROUND(AVG(decision = 'INCERTAIN'), 2) AS part_incertain,
       ROUND(AVG(confiance), 2) AS confiance_moyenne,
       SUM(contestations > 0) AS contestees
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY contrat_id ORDER BY part_incertain DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT contrat_id AS contrat, COUNT(*) AS analyses,
       ROUND(AVG(decision = 'INCERTAIN'), 2) AS part_incertain,
       ROUND(AVG(confiance), 2) AS confiance_moyenne,
       SUM(contestations > 0) AS contestees
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY contrat_id ORDER BY part_incertain DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT evenement, bien, lieu, COUNT(*) AS analyses FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY evenement, bien, lieu ORDER BY analyses DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT evenement, bien, lieu, COUNT(*) AS analyses FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY evenement, bien, lieu ORDER BY analyses DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Questions à poser à l'assuré les plus fréquentes
panels.description: Les informations à aller chercher ailleurs : souvent les conditions particulières.

targets.queryText:
SELECT q.value AS question, COUNT(*) AS fois
FROM analyses, json_each(analyses.questions) AS q
WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY q.value ORDER BY fois DESC LIMIT 15
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT q.value AS question, COUNT(*) AS fois
FROM analyses, json_each(analyses.questions) AS q
WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY q.value ORDER BY fois DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Versions des consignes en service
panels.description: Chaque réponse porte les versions des consignes et le modèle qui l'ont produite (voir `couverture versions`).

targets.queryText:
SELECT consignes, juge, MIN(date) AS depuis, COUNT(*) AS analyses,
       ROUND(AVG(decision = 'INCERTAIN'), 2) AS part_incertain,
       SUM(contestations > 0) AS contestees, CAST(AVG(duree_ms) AS INTEGER) AS duree_moyenne_ms
FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY consignes, juge ORDER BY depuis DESC
targets.rawQueryText:

FROM analyses WHERE erreur IS NULL AND unixepoch(date) BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo()
